cases.scope: Source characterization, no repaired initializer: fresh zeroed non-root VM, one global-root registration, one ordinary heartbeat/terminate interrupt, initial generations 0/1, one sequential constructor. Tracks root/list-link preparation before publication and ordinary interrupt masking before P0 readiness. Fault controls remove existing guards or propose mutex acquisition in a same-thread asynchronous handler; they are not attributed source/native defects. Uses sequential consistency and abstracts list fields, root-table readiness and normal returning P0 setup. Excludes synchronous/procedural interrupt APIs, pointer/data-race refinement, partial allocation/failure, unpublication, freeing, signal-handler drain and native acceptance.
